design: One trajectory per arm per seed on six previously selected development episodes. Full precedes control. Pairing is by task and seed. The prompted diagnostic is excluded.
reward_summary: Equal episode weights. A recorded no-submission earns zero. Missing, ineligible, incompatible and infrastructure-failed trajectories have separate counts. Target and control counts require two fresh native grades.
token_summary: Input includes cached input. Output includes reasoning. Total is input plus output. First-response input includes the initial editor instructions, task packet and tool schemas. Cost is a conservative provider upper bound in USD, excluding GPU charges. Coverage for each usage sum includes all scheduled cases with that measurement.
